about: The shared list of practical supports. Learners choose from it; employers say which they offer. Never diagnoses.

request.en: Please send tests and forms that work with a screen reader.
request.am: እባክዎ ከስክሪን አንባቢ ጋር የሚሰሩ ፈተናዎችና ቅጾች ይላኩ።

request.en: Please use simple words, and audio where possible.
Please arrange an Ethiopian Sign Language interpreter for the interview.
request.am: እባክዎ ለቃለ መጠይቅ የኢትዮጵያ ምልክት ቋንቋ አስተርጓሚ ያዘጋጁ።

request.en: Please contact me by text message, not phone calls.
Please allow extra time for tests.
Please hold the interview in a step-free room.
request.am: እባክዎ ቃለ መጠይቁን ደረጃ በሌለው ክፍል ያድርጉ።
